name: CaseFocusRingDeclaredStyleOnly
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "focus-ring-declared-style-only" (interaction-states). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a link whose focus ring is spelled ONLY as a KEYWORD flip — the rest plane carries `outline-width: 3px; outline-style: none` with no `outline-color` of its own (so it computes to `currentColor`), and `:focus-visible` sets `outline-style: solid; outline-width: 2px; outline-offset: 2px` and nothing else
